items.title: News in two tabs
items.text: Game news and Updates now have their own tabs. Updates lists every change to the game. Game news shows the next collection and when it comes out.

items.title: Nineteen more collections
items.text: Expedition to Power Keepers join the release calendar after Neo Destiny, one every 12 days. New rarities: Pokémon-ex (E) and Gold Star (★).

items.title: Card values rebalanced
items.text: A booster from any collection is now worth about the same against its price. Cards that are harder to pull are worth more: a holo in a set with many holos, or a lone Secret Rare.

items.text: 165 cards.

items.title: Warehouses, campaigns and bigger teams
items.text: Up to 30 staff, each with a main and a backup job for a chosen collection. Boxes and accessories now take storage space. New Properties tab with warehouses that restock the shop, and a Marketing tab with Flyers, Radio and TV campaigns.

items.title: Tidier News
items.text: News now has two parts, Game news and Updates, each showing the latest five with Read more. Rival purchases are grouped into one notice per collection.

items.title: Six more collections
items.text: Gym Heroes, Gym Challenge and the four Neo sets join the release calendar after Team Rocket, one every 12 days.

items.title: Gym Heroes is out
items.text: 132 cards. Gym Leaders and their Pokémon arrive in the shop.

items.title: Gym Challenge is out
items.text: 132 cards. More Gym Leaders, and their strongest Pokémon.

items.title: Neo Genesis is out
items.text: 111 cards. A new region, new Pokémon and baby Pokémon.

items.title: Neo Discovery is out
items.text: 75 cards. Unown and more new Pokémon.

items.title: Neo Revelation is out
items.text: 66 cards. Legendary birds and dogs, plus two Shining Secret Rares.

items.title: Neo Destiny is out
items.text: 113 cards. Light and Dark Pokémon, plus eight Shining Secret Rares.

items.title: Room for 10,000 boosters
items.text: Bigger storage now grows faster with each level, up to 10,000 sealed boosters at the top level.

items.title: Happier customers
items.text: Customers buy at market price 9 times in 10 and still take a card up to 30% above market about half the time. Rich customers are less strict. Reprints are smaller, and old collections get smaller reprints over time. Storage has a cleaner layout, and News and Awards close from the corner.

items.title: Collectors
items.text: Fame brings bigger budgets: at level 20 everyday customers spend up to $240 and over a third are collectors who go straight for your priciest cards.

items.title: Storage, Finances, salaries and awards
items.text: Sell sealed boosters, booster boxes and accessories from the new Storage tab. Staff now earn a daily salary, and the Finances tab shows income and costs by day. Earn awards for milestones and complete collections, and pick one of ten themes in Settings.

items.title: New faces and a fancier shop
items.text: Seven new kinds of customers visit the shop, and high Fame levels add shelves of booster boxes, string lights, a gold sign and more.

items.title: Smoother big shops
items.text: The Binder and Showcase stay smooth with a fully automated shop.

items.title: The shop stays busy
items.text: Customers keep coming while you are on another tab or the browser is minimized, so the shop is still busy when you return to it.

items.title: Livelier shop floor
items.text: Customers now browse together, each at their own pace. They wander along the showcase, glance around and take turns to speak.

items.title: Sales on the shop floor
items.text: Every customer who buys now appears on the shop floor and shows what they paid.

items.title: Market and showcase tweaks
items.text: Market search now covers every collection, and both the Market and the Showcase show each card's collection and number. Buy 10, Buy 100 and Buy all at the distributor. Supply shows the exact count.

items.title: Shop floor
items.text: See your customers walk in, check the showcase and tell you what they think of your prices. The showcase fills up as you list cards, and the shop gets new decor as your Fame grows.

items.title: Faster days and Fame
items.text: A market day now lasts 10 minutes, the same for everyone. A new collection comes out every 12 days. The new Fame upgrade brings more customers, and some with up to $1,000 to spend. Right after a release, some customers come only for the new collection. Older saves start over.

items.title: What customers think
items.text: The Showcase now shows how customers feel about each tag: cheap, fair, pricey or too pricey. The Customers box lists who looked at what, and whether they bought.

items.title: Easier listing
items.text: Price now lists every card, cheap ones too. In the binder, open a card and tap List to pick quantity and price. Team Rocket's Dark Raichu is now a Secret Rare, rarer than a holo.

items.title: Limited print runs
items.text: Every collection has a limited print run. Rival shops buy boosters every day, so prices rise as supply drops. Reprints bring them down. Boosters can now be bought and sold on the Market. A new collection comes out every 7 days. Older saves start over.
